web-guide-idea-4.audience: Existing followers of a spiritual teacher who want a focused live gathering.
web-guide-idea-4.offer: Organise a ticketed satsang with the teacher’s permission, a clear theme and a moderator. The value is an uninterrupted talk and thoughtfully selected questions, not a promise that every viewer gets a private answer.
web-guide-idea-4.steps.0: Agree the teacher’s topic, permission and appearance arrangements.
web-guide-idea-4.steps.1: Collect questions in advance and moderate the live talk.
web-guide-idea-4.steps.2: Close with a short recap and announce a genuinely different follow-up theme.
web-guide-idea-4.equipment: A well-positioned phone, dependable internet and quiet room can work. For a large event, add a microphone, moderator and a tested backup connection.
web-guide-idea-4.returnReason: Followers return for a coherent series such as understanding a text over several sessions. Publish the next topic and who will actually speak.
web-guide-idea-4.promotion: Promote through the teacher’s authorised channels. Make the teacher’s involvement clear; do not use a famous person’s name or likeness without agreement.
